_doc: VGA colour-cycling table. Layout `{uint16 count; struct {uint8 len, phase, start, delay;} band[8];}` = 34 bytes, decoded from cycle_init (VICEROY file 0x0C4A4) and cycle_colors (file 0x0C51A) -- the same cycle_1.c module MAPEDIT.EXE carries CodeView symbols for. Only the first `count` bands are read; the rest are uninitialised authoring-tool bytes, which is why the tail of the file disassembles as stray x86. `phase` is runtime state, zeroed by cycle_init, so its value on disk is dead too. See docs/PALETTE_AND_CYCLING.md and notes/rulings/RULINGS.md 2026-08-05.

timer._doc: cycle_colors reads the 60 Hz counter [0x92E8]: PIT divisor 0x7A8 (push 0x7a8 @0x0C843), the ISR's even-tick gate (@0x0C6A5) and its [0x376] reload of 5 (@0x0C70B).

rotation._doc: STD + three descending rep movsb @0x0C5B2-0x0C5F3: each colour moves to the next HIGHER index, the last wraps into the first. After p steps index start+k shows the colour authored at start + ((k-p) mod len).
